# Publish gate report: Rooibos Chai product page

**Going out:** product page copy for Rooibos Chai, UK, public.

**Not publishable as written.** One line fails the claims and regulated-claims checks.

## Claims check
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Caffeine-free rooibos with cinnamon, cardamom, ginger and black pepper | Product fact (ingredients), fine as written |
| Lovely with milk | Taste opinion, no factual claim, fine |
| 100g tin | Product fact (tin size), fine |
| "It cured my bloating in a week" - verified buyer | **Fails.** It is a health claim, and the policy bans health claims of any kind, including "cures". It is also a testimonial with no permission or source on record. |

## Regulated claims (health)
- **Risky line:** "It cured my bloating in a week".
- **Why:** it says the tea cures a medical symptom. Putting a customer's words on our own page makes it our claim, and "verified buyer" does not change that.
- **Safer version:** remove the line. The rest of the copy already sells the tea.

## House style
The copy is warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words and no AI tells. The score is about 90. No rewrite is needed beyond the removal.

## Disclosure
Nothing to label. It is our own product page with no partnership, affiliate link or AI content.

## Fixed
- I did not edit the draft. The suggested change is to delete the testimonial.

## Suggested copy
> Rooibos Chai. Caffeine-free rooibos with cinnamon, cardamom, ginger and black pepper. Lovely with milk. 100g tin.

## Needs a decision
- Confirm the testimonial is deleted. If the team wants a customer quote, it needs written permission and wording that says nothing about health, such as "Lovely with a splash of milk."

## Approver
Sam (marketing lead). I have not recorded an approval. Sam needs to say yes to the final wording above, and any change after that means a new check.
